results.title: Kivi srl is a manufacturing Company of driving devices and transfer aid systems to facilitate both the transfer to the car for people with reduced mobility and the wheelchair loading. | Kivi manufactures and adapts cars, so that they can be driven directly from one’s own wheelchair.
results.content:
Kivi products are “tailor-made”: we create handmade solutions that perfectly adapt to the passenger compartment, which grants safe and secure driving while providing the car with exemplary aesthetics. We believe that independence is a fundamental principle contributing to raise the quality of life for all of us and nothing makes us more proud than giving our contribution to increase that level in the life of more people. [...] We export our products to Europe and around the World. Our company has a Quality Management System Certified ISO 9001 and all our products are approved by the Italian Ministry of Transport and by the local government authorities of many European countries such as the Spanish Ministry of Transport and Motability in the United Kingdom. Kivi is also an active partner of the mobility program Autonomy of Fiat Chrysler Automobiles. [...] Our constant commitment is addressed to research solutions to help disabled people to improve their mobility through designing, manufacturing and marketing of:

 - Driving aids

 - Vehicle access aids

 - Wheelchair loading systems

 - Wheelchair Accessible Vehicles (WAVs)

 - Driving from the wheelchair
